messages.subject: GCC Mining & Natural Resources Leadership | ESG, Government Relations and Country Strategy
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Gulanes,

Kepler Search's executive-search work across metals and mining, energy, infrastructure and natural resources makes this a focused introduction for senior GCC mandates.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My remit spans senior government and regulatory relations, ESG and sustainability, external and corporate affairs, social performance, strategic partnerships, executive advisory and cross-functional country-facing delivery within a major gold-mining operation.

My experience is strongest where complex industrial operations intersect with ministries, regulators, communities, investment priorities, energy transition and executive decision-making. Across 12+ years, I have worked across multinational mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations.

Saudi Arabia is my first GCC priority, followed by the UAE. I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Country Leadership, External or Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, ESG and Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Chief of Staff and Executive Operations mandates across mining, metals, energy, infrastructure and industrial development. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice.

I would value consideration for current or upcoming searches where institutional engagement, sustainability and complex operating experience fit the brief. My Gulf-focused executive CV is attached.

Preferred reply/contact: ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
